schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
schemes.name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment

eligibility.education_level: Post-matriculation or post-secondary stage (Class 11, Class 12, ITI, Diploma, Graduation, Post-Graduation)
eligibility.attendance_requirement: Regular attendance as per institution guidelines

schemes.benefits: Compulsory non-refundable fees covered plus annual maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500 depending on course group and hosteller/day scholar status.

schemes.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)
schemes.name_hi: कॉलेज और विश्वविद्यालय के छात्रों के लिए केंद्रीय क्षेत्र छात्रवृत्ति योजना (PM-USP)
schemes.ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education

eligibility.education_level: Passed Class 12 in current academic year and enrolled in regular (non-correspondence) degree courses in recognized colleges/universities
eligibility.merit_criteria: Above 80th percentile of successful candidates in relevant stream from respective Board of Examination in Class 12
eligibility.category: All categories (General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS)
eligibility.other_conditions: Must not be availing benefits of any other state or central scholarship scheme

schemes.benefits: ₹12,000 per annum at graduation level for first 3 years of college; ₹20,000 per annum at post-graduation level.
required_documents: Class 12 Marksheet (with roll number verifying > 80th percentile)
College Admission Fee Receipt & Student ID
